title: Gluing monoid-sheaf morphisms and isomorphisms over a fixed sheaf
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site with fibre products [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], and $\{U_a\to U\}_{a\in I}$ a covering family. Use the size convention [def-weil-size-convention] in a universe containing the site, $I$, all section sets and their indexed products, and slice-site restrictions [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. Let $R,A,B$ be sheaves of commutative monoids on $\mathcal C/U$: their underlying set presheaves are sheaves, their sections are commutative monoids and their restrictions are homomorphisms. Let $\alpha:A\to R$ and $\beta:B\to R$ be monoid-sheaf homomorphisms. Suppose $u_a:A|_{U_a}\to B|_{U_a}$ are monoid-sheaf homomorphisms with $\beta|_{U_a}u_a=\alpha|_{U_a}$ and their restrictions agree on every $U_a\times_UU_b$. There is a unique monoid-sheaf homomorphism $u:A\to B$ with $\beta u=\alpha$ restricting to all the $u_a$. If every $u_a$ is an isomorphism, $u$ is an isomorphism over $R$, and its inverse restricts to every $u_a^{-1}$. No log condition, integrality, finite generation or saturation is assumed on $A,B,R$.

source.place: Tag 04TQ, lemma-glue-maps; preservation of monoid operations and maps to R by separatedness, followed by gluing of inverse maps.

proof.text: Identify the usual Hom sheaf on C/U with the Hom presheaf of the pseudofunctor J.pseudofunctorOver CommMonCat. At T -> U the equivalence precomposes a natural transformation with the inverse iterated-slice equivalence C/T -> (C/U)/T, as in [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. Naturality follows from naturality along the canonical identity-underlying-arrow isomorphism between the two repeated restrictions. Mathlib sheafHom supplies the sheaf condition for arbitrary category-valued sheaves, so this gives the IsPrestack instance. This glues actual monoid-sheaf maps, without forgetting their operations.

Apply Mathlib Pseudofunctor.fullyFaithfulToDescentData to the covering sieve of [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Let u be the preimage of localMap under its Hom equivalence. Its image is exactly localMap. Applying faithfulness to u composed with beta and alpha proves the structural-map equation, since it holds in every component by hbase. Applying faithfulness once more proves uniqueness of u.

When every local component is invertible, Pseudofunctor.DescentData.isoMk assembles their asIso isomorphisms: its compatibility condition is localMap.comm, and its inverse components are exactly the specified local inverses. Take the preimage isomorphism under the fully faithful restriction functor. Its hom is u by construction; its inverse composed with alpha equals beta by the structural equation and the inverse-hom identity. The map-preimage equality on its inverse, evaluated at each index, proves the required inverse restriction. These categorical arguments allow empty covers and repeated indices.

proof_origin.place: Tags 04TQ (lemma-glue-maps) and 03EH (lemma-relocalize), implemented via Mathlib SheafHom and fullyFaithfulToDescentData; the iterated-slice comparison follows the proved private comparison in Sheaf.CategoryTheory.SetSheafCoverDescent.

lean.statement: theorem monoidSheafMorphism_gluing {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [HasPullbacks C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C) {I : Type w} (U : C) (X : I → C) (f : ∀ i, X i ⟶ U) (hcov : Sieve.ofArrows X f ∈ J U) (R A B : Sheaf (J.over U) CommMonCat.{max u v w}) (α : A ⟶ R) (β : B ⟶ R) (localMap : ((J.pseudofunctorOver CommMonCat.{max u v w}).toDescentData f).obj A ⟶ ((J.pseudofunctorOver CommMonCat.{max u v w}).toDescentData f).obj B) (hbase : ∀ i, localMap.hom i ≫ (J.overMapPullback CommMonCat.{max u v w} (f i)).map β = (J.overMapPullback CommMonCat.{max u v w} (f i)).map α) : ∃ u : A ⟶ B, (u ≫ β = α ∧ ((J.pseudofunctorOver CommMonCat.{max u v w}).toDescentData f).map u = localMap) ∧ (∀ u' : A ⟶ B, u' ≫ β = α → ((J.pseudofunctorOver CommMonCat.{max u v w}).toDescentData f).map u' = localMap → u' = u) ∧ (∀ hiso : ∀ i, IsIso (localMap.hom i), ∃ e : A ≅ B, e.hom = u ∧ e.inv ≫ α = β ∧ ∀ i, (J.overMapPullback CommMonCat.{max u v w} (f i)).map e.inv = @CategoryTheory.inv _ _ _ _ (localMap.hom i) (hiso i))
